Hi Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side.

What we covered:
- Higher-level options: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools), Private VPC / on-prem (full network + KMS control).
- Your primary requirement: strict data isolation for customer data, ability to use customer-managed KMS, and audit/log access for compliance.
- Timeline: you mentioned wanting a vendor selected within ~6 weeks.

Questions / asks for you:
1) Can you confirm whether FinSecure needs an on-prem / air-gapped deployment, or would a Private VPC (customer VPC peering / private link) with BYOK KMS be sufficient?
2) Please share the network contact (name/email) who can provide account/VPC details and any IP allowlist constraints.
3) Any procurement-specific redlines we should expect around audit access / retention?

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll loop in Marissa (Solutions Engineering) for a technical deep-dive this week to review Private VPC architecture and checklist.
- I’ll send a short draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a ballpark pricing comparison for Dedicated vs Private.

Attachments: redwood-deployment-options.pdf (short comparison), SOC2-summary.pdf

If those next steps look good I can send a calendar invite for a technical call.

Best,

We are not looking for a fully air-gapped on-prem deployment today, but it would be helpful to understand that option (and any lead time / cost delta) in case our regulator asks for it later.

Timeline: the 6-week window still stands for vendor selection - procurement/IT are on that cadence.

Action items for you:
- Can you send a high-level architecture diagram for the Private VPC flow (how data flows, where logs are retained, who has access)?
- Ballpark pricing for Private VPC vs Dedicated (monthly committed capacity vs private deployment premium).
- Draft MAP would be great.

Looping in legal (legal@finsecure.com) for procurement redlines; they may have standard language around audit and data retention.
